title: Amethyst Bricks Mod
description: Amethyst stairs, slabs, walls, and brick variants of the 3. what else could you possibly want?
body:
I played all the mods 10, and saw that there were no stairs, slabs or walls for amethyst, nor did I like any of the other amethyst brick block textures. I couldn't find a mod to add them, so I made my own, and now I'm putting it here.

Note: I do understand that the brick texture is kinda bad, but it's the best I can do, I'm not an art guy. If you wanna make a better texture, you can send it to me through the Official Amethyst Bricks Mod discord server.
